abstract: Maintains perimeter defense, intrusion detection, and active on-site guard staffing records
system_message:
You are the Security and site protection lead (SEC), responsible for maintaining perimeter defense, intrusion detection, and active on-site guard staffing records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Biometric portal verification（BIOM）
information_points.content:
SEC-BIOM-OUV：Records for the Chianti Geological Archive Vault indicate a biometric access verification throughput of 18 scans/min at the primary vault security airlock portal.
SEC-BIOM-RVZ：At the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository, the primary vault security airlock portal achieves a biometric access verification throughput of 24 scans/min.
SEC-BIOM-T8P：The Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum logs demonstrate a biometric access verification throughput of 30 scans/min at the primary vault security airlock portal.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter defense, intrusion detection, and active on-site guard staffing records（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SEC-GUARD-FQ3：For the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository, the active security surveillance guard count across the 24-hour physical perimeter and control console watch is 8 guards stationed on active duty per shift.
SEC-GUARD-GKO：At the Chianti Geological Archive Vault, the active security surveillance guard count maintained for the 24-hour physical perimeter and control console watch is 8 guards on active duty per shift.
SEC-GUARD-NOU：According to the security operations shift roster for the Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum, the active security surveillance guard count for the 24-hour physical perimeter and control console watch is 6 guards on active duty per shift.
